{{Top|leg}}
'''Affliceria''' was a disease spread through airborne bacterium. It started with a [[Cold/Legends|head cold]] which would rapidly develop into raging fevers and severe dehydration. Left untreated, the disease could [[Death/Legends|kill]]. The cure was found a hundred [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and it was pronounced extinct not long after. As retaliation for the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] dropped on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] population centers, Commenori [[Spy/Legends|spies]] began spreading the disease on the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Due to having no stores of the antibiotic for the disease, the epidemic spread rampantly through the population and resulted in massive personnel shortage in critical fabrication industries.
